text:
"never stop moving the ball forward" -- on shifts of fortune, the four levels of the game, the self-contained man, and 'keep showing up to life.'

TIMESTAMPS:

(00:00) intro
(03:00) the four levels of the game: physical, mental, emotional, spiritual
(05:00) what it means to move the ball forward
(07:00) on physical and mental, habits, reading, love and presence
(09:00) knowledge is everywhere, it’s the desire to learn that’s scarce
(10:30) emotional volatility
(11:30) spirituality, higher powers greater than oneself
(13:00) when your life comes to a full stop + "make all the changes at once"
(14:30) courage, discipline, willpower, and inertia / "going against your gut is the ultimate betrayal"
(16:00) putting helmets on the ball + "the weather of the mind"
(18:00) fears melt away as they're faced head on
(20:00) when you've got 11 helmets flying to the ball / gang-tackling
(21:30) the limits of hardship compression + the protective bubble of habits
(23:00) the self-contained man
(24:30) "nothing overwrites failure like success"
(26:00) you may hate the path you took, but you'll love where you end up
